epub.js 0.3.93 (BSD-2-Clause / FreeBSD)
Source: https://github.com/futurepress/epub.js
Build: epubjs 0.3.93 dist/epub.min.js (classic UMD, JSZip as a global).
Why this build: 0.3 is the supported line; the UMD file is a classic script
the packer can inline. Rendition's iframe view cannot run here (the app
frame-src is none, and the sandbox is opaque), so the app uses Book /
Archive / Navigation / CFI from this file and paginates in a div.
